name: David
source:
Ati's comrade, both of them are Runners, most of their work take place around the City Skyscraper.
He has implanted Crack Engines with motor reflexes. 
He's fast, faster than most, that's valuable in and of itself.
When this guy's around, survival rates go up.
(Edited from in-game text)
